name: todo_manager
spec: Create a command-line todo manager in Python using only the standard library. Users manage tasks through text commands in a REPL. Each task has a title, priority level, completion status, and creation timestamp. Tasks persist between sessions via a JSON file. Support filtering, sorting, and basic search.
features: Runs in a REPL loop accepting text commands
User can add a task with a title and optional priority (low, medium, high) via an 'add' command
User can list all tasks showing ID, title, priority, status, and creation date
User can mark a task as complete by its ID with a 'done' command
User can delete a task by its ID with a 'delete' command
User can filter tasks by status with 'list active' and 'list done'
User can sort tasks by priority or date with 'list --sort priority' or 'list --sort date'
User can search tasks by keyword with a 'search' command
Tasks are saved to a JSON file automatically after every change
Tasks are loaded from the JSON file on startup if it exists
Handles invalid commands and task IDs gracefully with helpful error messages
User can type 'help' to see available commands
User can type 'quit' or 'exit' to stop the program
